headline: Control an Edimax plug on your network
intro: Edimax connects a Smart Plug to Home Assistant through its host address and username and password. The integration exposes a switch that can turn the plug on or off and polls the device for its current state.
highlights: Configure the plug host and optional name, username, and password.
Turn the Smart Plug on or off with a Home Assistant switch entity.
The device MAC address supplies the entity's unique ID, and its state is polled locally.

flow.title: From plug to switch control
stages: Set the plug host and credentials
Poll state and control the switch
